text.en:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perlembagaan Persekutuan
(Kajian Semula Pemberian Khas di bawah Perkara 112D) (Negeri Sabah) 2022.

Pemberian khas

2. Bagi tempoh lima tahun berkuat kuasa mulai 1 Januari 2022, Kerajaan Persekutuan
hendaklah membuat kepada  Negeri Sabah , berkenaan dengan tahun kewangan  2022,
2023, 202 4, 202 5 dan 202 6, pemberian berjumlah RM125.6 juta, RM 129.7 juta,
RM133.8 juta, RM138.1 juta dan RM142.6 juta masing-masingnya.

Pembatalan

3. Perentah Pemberian Khas Sabah (Ulangkaji Pertama) , 1970 [ P.U. (A) 328/1970 ]
dibatalkan.

Dibuat 17 April 2022
[MOF.NBO(R)600-8/4/1 JLD.3(5); PN(PU2)171/XXV]

 Dengan Titah Perintah

TENGKU DATUK SERI UTAMA ZAFRUL BIN TENGKU ABDUL AZIZ
                                                     Menteri Kewangan

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION (REVIEW OF SPECIAL GRANT UNDER ARTICLE 112D)
(STATE OF SABAH) ORDER 2022

WHEREAS by virtue of Clause (1) of Article 112 D of the Federal Constitution,
the special grant made to the State of Sabah as specified in paragraph (a) Clause (1)
of Article 112 C of the Federal Constitution shall be reviewed by the Government s
of the Federation and the State of Sabah;

 AND WHEREAS the review was held by the Government s of the Federation
and the State of Sabah on 14 February 2022;

 AND WHEREAS the said review has resulted in the Governments of the Federation
and the State of Sabah agreeing that for the period of five years with effect
from 2022 to 202 6, the Government of the Federation shall make to the Government
of the State of Sabah, in respect of each financial year, another grant instead of the grant
made under the Sabah Special Grant (First Review) Order, 1970 [P.U. (A) 328/1970];

 NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by Clause (1) of Article 112D
of the Federal Constitution, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:
